name: BMC Helix
description: Connect your own BMC Helix ITSM (Remedy AR System) instance to manage Incidents, Problems, Changes, Work Orders, Knowledge Articles, and CMDB CIs through the AR System Data REST API, plus a generic form passthrough.

tools.name: connect_bmc_helix
tools.description: Connect a BMC Helix ITSM (Remedy AR System) instance via JWT login, after validating connectivity.

tools.name: disconnect_bmc_helix
tools.description: Disconnect a BMC Helix instance: deletes only the saved credentials. Nothing in BMC Helix itself is changed.

connection_id.description: Saved BMC Helix connection ID to remove from Imperal.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List the connected BMC Helix instances.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents on the connected BMC Helix instance, optionally filtered by status.

connection_id.description: Optional saved BMC Helix connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_incident

connection_id.description: Optional saved BMC Helix connection ID. Omit to use the first connected instance.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

entry_id.description: AR System entry id (the form's primary key value, e.g. Incident Number).
